feedback.problem: Calculate the $x$-coordinates of the points where the hyperbola $5{y}^{2}-16{x}^{2}=36$ intersects the line $y=-2x.$
feedback.worked_solution:
To find the points where the hyperbola intersects the line $y=-2x,$ we first replace $y$ with $-2x$ in the equation of the hyperbola and solve for $x,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}5{y}^{2}-16{x}^{2} & =36 \\ 5(-2x)^{2}-16{x}^{2} & =36 \\ 5(4{x}^{2})-16{x}^{2} & =36 \\ 20{x}^{2}-16{x}^{2} & =36 \\ 4{x}^{2} & =36 \\ {x}^{2} & =9 \\ x & =\pm 3\end{aligned}
$$
